resources.string: Wrist Dialer runs quietly in the background and waits for call requests from your watch.
Required. Lets the app place the call your watch asks for.
Required. Lets the app listen for your watch through Garmin Connect.
Optional. Only shows the \"Watching for call requests\" status notification; calls work without it.
Stops Android from closing the app while the phone is locked.
Turning a permission off in Android settings makes Android close the app. This is normal - the app restarts its background listener by itself.
Bluetooth permission is required - open App permissions to allow it
Phone call and Bluetooth permissions are required - open App permissions to allow them
